chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When you buy something from goods or otherwise, exclaim Takbeer, then say: 'O Allah, I have bought it seeking from Your Grace, so send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. O Allah, make for me therein a grace. O Allah, I have bought it seeking from Your sustenance, so make for me therein sustenance.' Then repeat each one three times.

key_terms.مَتَاعٍ: Goods, merchandise, or items for use

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended prayer to recite when buying goods in Islam?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a spiritual protocol for commercial transactions, transforming mundane purchases into acts of worship by seeking divine blessing (*fadl*) and sustenance (*rizq*) in the acquired goods. The repetition of the supplication three times reflects the Shia emphasis on consistency in dhikr to internalize gratitude and reliance on Allah, ensuring that material gain is accompanied by spiritual prosperity.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whenever you buy anything from a shop or something else, so exclaim Takbeer, then say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I am buyind it, seeking therein from Your<sup>azwj</sup> Grace, so Send Blessings upon Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>! O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! So Make Grace to be therein for me! O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I am buying it seeking therein Grace from Your<sup>azwj</sup> sustenance. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! So Make sustenance to be therein for me’. Then repeat each one three times’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn Hariz who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When you buy merchandise or something say Takbir (Allah is great beyond description). Then say, ‘O Allah, I have purchased this and I seek in it your extra favor, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause. O Allah, place in it of your extra favors. O Allah, I have purchased it and seek in it sustenance from You. O Allah, place sustenance in it.’ Thereafter repeat each of the above three times.”’
